what: The plan adds lint-side step_markers placement checks but the test-script update only says to derive paths and expected_count, not to parse step_markers or generate marker-bounded fixture bodies.
scenario_or_breakage: The existing compliant fixture shape writes repeated directive lines without <!-- step:... --> anchors. After the proposed lint change, that fixture fails with missing step-marker errors, or the harness may special-case fixtures and drift from lint parsing.
suggested_fix: Specify that test-lint-readability-preamble.sh reads the same five TSV fields with the same skip/default/validation rules, and for non-empty step_markers creates fixture bodies with those step anchors and directives inside each named step body. Empty step_markers should keep using expected_count for existing fixture assertions.

what: The B6 tsv-is-source-of-truth case is specified as proving the lint script iterates the synthetic TSV row, not that the test script parser reads every TSV row.
scenario_or_breakage: An implementation could leave the test harness path lists effectively hardcoded, add a synthetic TSV row, and assert lint stderr names that row. B6 would pass while the test parser still ignores new TSV rows for fixture generation and expected_count derivation.
suggested_fix: Revise B6 so the extra TSV row must be consumed by the test harness parser itself, for example by requiring the manifest-derived fixture writer to create the extra file and asserting the compliant synthetic fixture passes only because that parsed row was handled.
